example: すべての人には教育を受ける権利があります。
example_reading: すべてのひとにはきょういくをうけるけんりがあります。
translation: Everyone has the right to receive an education.
components: 木 (tree) beside the complex right side built around 隹 (short-tailed bird), a visual cue for authority.
mnemonic: Picture a hand holding a tree as a symbol of power and rights.
warning: 権利 means a right; 権力 means power or authority.

example: 家族がいつも私を支えてくれます。
example_reading: かぞくがいつもわたしをささえてくれます。
translation: My family always supports me.
components: 十 over 又, a hand bracing something.
mnemonic: Imagine a hand supporting a cross shaped beam.
warning: 支払う means to pay; 支える means to support.

kunyomi: うむ; うまれる; うぶ
example: この工場では車を年間五万台生産しています。
example_reading: このこうじょうではくるまをねんかんごまんだいせいさんしています。
translation: This factory produces fifty thousand cars a year.
components: 産 combines 立 (stand), 厂 (shelter), and 生 (life).
mnemonic: Picture new life standing up in a sheltered place.
warning: 産む is transitive ‘give birth’; 生まれる is intransitive ‘be born’.

example: 試験の点数が思ったより高かった。
example_reading: しけんのてんすうがおもったよりたかかった。
translation: My test score was higher than I expected.
components: 占 (occupy) over four dots of fire.
mnemonic: A marked point glows like a tiny flame on a map.
warning: 点数 is a score; 店 is a shop and has a different character.

kunyomi: むくいる; しらせる
example: 調査の結果を上司に報告した。
example_reading: ちょうさのけっかをじょうしにほうこくした。
translation: I reported the results of the investigation to my supervisor.
components: 幸 (fortune) and 卩 with 又, a hand delivering news.
mnemonic: A hand delivers fortunate news in a formal report.
warning: 報道 is news reporting; 報告 is a report to someone.

example: 支払いが済んだら、領収書を受け取ってください。
example_reading: しはらいがすんだら、りょうしゅうしょをうけとってください。
translation: Once the payment is settled, please receive the receipt.
components: 氵 (water) beside 齊, things brought into order.
mnemonic: Picture water levels becoming even when a task is settled.
warning: 済む is intransitive; 済ませる means to finish or settle something.

kunyomi: いきる; いかす; いける
example: 退職後も地域の活動に参加している。
example_reading: たいしょくごもちいきのかつどうにさんかしている。
translation: Even after retirement, I take part in local activities.
components: 氵 (water) with 舌 (tongue), flowing speech and life.
mnemonic: A tongue beside flowing water suggests lively movement.
warning: 生活 means life or living; 活用 means practical use or conjugation.

example: 事故の原因はまだ分かっていません。
example_reading: じこのげんいんはまだわかっていません。
translation: The cause of the accident is still unknown.
components: 厂 (cliff) over 泉 (spring), an original source.
mnemonic: Imagine a spring emerging from beneath a cliff at the source of a plain.
warning: 原 is ‘origin’; 元 is ‘former/original’ and appears in 元気.

example: 二人は共通の趣味を通して知り合った。
example_reading: ふたりはきょうつうのしゅみをとおしてしりあった。
translation: The two people met through a hobby they shared.
components: Two hands hold the same object beneath a table-like top.
mnemonic: Picture several hands sharing one valuable object.
warning: 共に is usually ともに; 共通 is read きょうつう.

example: 努力すれば、貴重な経験を得られる。
example_reading: どりょくすれば、きちょうなけいけんをえられる。
translation: If you work hard, you can gain valuable experience.
components: 彳 (step) beside 日 and 寸, taking something by measured steps.
mnemonic: Step carefully toward the sun and obtain a reward.
warning: 得る is える in modern speech; 得ない can mean ‘cannot obtain’.

kunyomi: とく; とかす; とける
example: 先生の説明で、文法の疑問が解決した。
example_reading: せんせいのせつめいで、ぶんぽうのぎもんがかいけつした。
translation: The teacher’s explanation resolved my grammar question.
components: 角 (horn), 刀 (sword), and 牛 (cow): separating parts.
mnemonic: Picture a sword cutting a horn from a cow to untie a puzzle.
warning: 解く can mean solve or untie; 解ける is the intransitive ‘be solved’.

kunyomi: まじわる; まじえる; まじる; まぜる; かう; かわす
romaji: kou; majiwaru; majieru; majiru; mazeru; kau; kawasu
example: 駅前で友達と本を交換した。
example_reading: えきまえでともだちとほんをこうかんした。
translation: I exchanged books with a friend in front of the station.
components: A person’s legs cross under a lid-like shape.
mnemonic: Two paths cross as people exchange places.
warning: 交通 is transportation; 交差点 specifically means intersection.

example: 会議の前に資料を全員へ配った。
example_reading: かいぎのまえにしりょうをぜんいんへくばった。
translation: I distributed the materials to everyone before the meeting.
components: 次 above 貝 (shell money), stored wealth and resources.
mnemonic: Imagine saving shell money to fund a project.
warning: 資料 means reference materials; 資料館 is an archive or materials museum.

example: 来月の予定をカレンダーに書き込んだ。
example_reading: らいげつのよていをカレンダーにかきこんだ。
translation: I wrote next month’s schedule into my calendar.
components: A bent hook shape with a small extending line, marking what comes beforehand.
mnemonic: Picture a hook reserving a place in advance.
warning: 予定 is a planned schedule; 予約 is a reservation.

kunyomi: むく; むける; むかう; むこう
example: 卒業後は海外で働く方向に進みたい。
example_reading: そつぎょうごはかいがいではたらくほうこうにすすみたい。
translation: After graduation, I want to move toward working overseas.
components: A window-like opening facing outward.
mnemonic: Imagine a window turned toward the road you will take.
warning: 向く means face or suit; 向ける means turn something toward.

example: 海外旅行の際には保険に入っておくと安心です。
example_reading: かいがいりょこうのさいにはほけんにはいっておくとあんしんです。
translation: When traveling abroad, it is reassuring to have insurance.
components: 阝 (place) beside 祭 (festival), marking an occasion or boundary.
mnemonic: A festival at a boundary marks a special occasion.
warning: 際に is formal ‘when’; 際立つ means stand out.

example: 最後まであきらめなかったチームが勝った。
example_reading: さいごまであきらめなかったチームがかった。
translation: The team that did not give up until the end won.
components: 力 (strength) under a boat-like 月/肉 form, strength prevailing.
mnemonic: Picture strength lifting a boat over the finish line.
warning: 勝つ is intransitive ‘win’; 勝たせる means let or make someone win.

kunyomi: おもて; おも; つら
example: 面接では自分の経験を具体的に話した。
example_reading: めんせつではじぶんのけいけんをぐたいてきにはなした。
translation: In the interview, I spoke specifically about my experience.
components: A broad 面 encloses an eye-like central mark, a face.
mnemonic: Imagine a face covering the flat surface of a mask.
warning: 面接 is an interview; 面倒 means troublesome and is read めんどう.

example: 変更があれば、すぐに担当者へ告げてください。
example_reading: へんこうがあれば、すぐにたんとうしゃへつげてください。
translation: If there are changes, please inform the person in charge immediately.
components: 牛 (cow) under a mouth, loudly telling others.
mnemonic: Picture announcing news loudly so everyone hears.
warning: 告げる is literary or formal; 伝える is more general ‘tell’.

onyomi: ハン; ホン; タン
example: 彼はその提案に反対の意見を述べた。
example_reading: かれはそのていあんにはんたいのいけんをのべた。
translation: He expressed an opposing opinion about the proposal.
components: 厂 (cliff) with 又, a hand turning back.
mnemonic: A hand turns back from the edge in the opposite direction.
warning: 反対 means opposite or opposed; 反応 means reaction.

example: 情報が足りないので、今は判断できない。
example_reading: じょうほうがたりないので、いまははんだんできない。
translation: There is not enough information, so I cannot decide yet.
components: 半 (half) beside 刀 (knife), separating and judging sides.
mnemonic: A knife divides two halves so a judge can decide.
warning: 判る is an alternate spelling of わかる; ordinary writing uses 分かる.

example: 予約内容を確認してから、送信ボタンを押した。
example_reading: よやくないようをかくにんしてから、そうしんボタンをおした。
translation: After checking the reservation details, I pressed the send button.
components: 言 (words) beside 忍 (endure), accepting words after consideration.
mnemonic: Listen patiently to words until you recognize their truth.
warning: 認める can mean admit, recognize, or approve depending on context.

example: 週末の清掃活動に参加する予定です。
example_reading: しゅうまつのせいそうかつどうにさんかするよていです。
translation: I plan to participate in the weekend cleanup activity.
components: Three small rays over 人, a person coming toward a place.
mnemonic: Picture a person approaching three guiding stars to join in.
warning: 参る is humble ‘go/come’; 参加 is ‘participate’, not merely attend.

example: このカードを利用すると、入場料が安くなる。
example_reading: このカードをりようすると、にゅうじょうりょうがやすくなる。
translation: Using this card makes the admission fee cheaper.
components: 禾 (grain) beside 刀 (blade), a sharp tool bringing benefit.
mnemonic: A sharp blade harvests grain efficiently for profit.
warning: 利く means work or be effective; 効く uses a different character.

example: 説明書を見ながら棚を組み立てた。
example_reading: せつめいしょをみながらたなをくみたてた。
translation: I assembled the shelf while looking at the instructions.
components: 糸 (thread) beside 且, threads joining parts together.
mnemonic: Picture threads binding separate pieces into one group.
warning: 組 means a group or class as a noun; 組む means assemble or team up.

example: 長年の経験があるので、彼を信頼している。
example_reading: ながねんのけいけんがあるので、かれをしんらいしている。
translation: I trust him because he has many years of experience.
components: 亻 (person) beside 言 (words): a person whose words are trusted.
mnemonic: Trust a person whose words match their actions.
warning: 信用 is credit or trustworthiness; 信じる is the verb ‘believe’.

example: 現在、この駅には多くの利用者がいます。
example_reading: げんざい、このえきにはおおくのりようしゃがいます。
translation: The station is farther along this street.
components: 土 (earth) under 才, something situated on the ground.
mnemonic: Picture an object firmly existing on the earth.
warning: 在る is formal or literary; ordinary location uses ある or いる.

example: その件については、後で詳しく説明します。
example_reading: そのけんについては、あとでくわしくせつめいします。
translation: I will explain that matter in detail later.
components: 亻 (person) beside 牛 (cow), one counted case or item.
mnemonic: Picture one person handling one clearly defined case.
warning: 件 is a counter for cases or matters; 個 is a general counter for objects.

example: 道路の右側を歩いてください。
example_reading: どうろのみぎがわをあるいてください。
translation: Please walk on the right side of the road.
components: 亻 (person) beside 則, a person alongside a rule.
mnemonic: A person stands at the side of a marked rule.
warning: ～側 is usually がわ after a noun; そば means beside or nearby.

example: この仕事は経験のある彼に任せよう。
example_reading: このしごとはけいけんのあるかれにまかせよう。
translation: Let us entrust this work to him, who has experience.
components: 亻 (person) over 壬, a person bearing an assigned duty.
mnemonic: Picture a person carrying a task handed to them.
warning: 任せる is entrust; 任務 is an assigned mission or duty.

example: 春に家族で新しい町へ引っ越した。
example_reading: はるにかぞくであたらしいまちへひっこした。
translation: In spring, my family moved to a new town.
components: 弓 (bow) with a long line being pulled.
mnemonic: Pull a bowstring straight toward yourself.
warning: 引く becomes ひっ in 引っ越す; 引き出す means withdraw or pull out.

example: 会社は新しい企画の提案を求めている。
example_reading: かいしゃはあたらしいきかくのていあんをもとめている。
translation: The company is seeking proposals for a new project.
components: A pictograph of a fur garment, something sought or requested.
mnemonic: Imagine reaching out to seek a warm coat.
warning: 求める can mean seek, request, or demand; the context controls the strength.

example: 待ち合わせ場所を駅の前に決めた。
example_reading: まちあわせばしょをえきのまえにきめた。
translation: We decided on a meeting place in front of the station.
components: 戸 (door) beside 斤 (axe), marking a particular place.
mnemonic: Picture an axe kept by one specific door as its place.
warning: 所 can be ところ in native words and しょ in compounds.

example: 次の駅で電車を乗り換えます。
example_reading: つぎのえきででんしゃをのりかえます。
translation: I will change trains at the next station.
components: 欠 (open mouth/yawn) beside two dots, one following another.
mnemonic: A yawn marks the next turn in a waiting line.
warning: 次第に means gradually; 次ぐ means follow or be next in rank.

example: 昨年より売上が大きく伸びた。
example_reading: さくねんよりうりあげがおおきくのびた。
translation: Sales grew considerably compared with last year.
components: 日 (sun/day) beside 乍, marking a previous day.
mnemonic: Picture yesterday’s sun already behind today’s page.
warning: 昨日 is commonly きのう; the formal reading さくじつ also exists.

example: 会議では環境問題について活発な議論が行われた。
example_reading: かいぎではかんきょうもんだいについてかっぱつなぎろんがおこなわれた。
translation: An active discussion about environmental problems took place at the meeting.
components: 言 (words) beside 侖, words arranged into a coherent argument.
mnemonic: Stack written ideas in order until they form a theory.
warning: 論文 means academic paper; 論争 means dispute or controversy.

example: 必要な書類を官公庁の窓口に提出した。
example_reading: ひつようなしょるいをかんこうちょうのまどぐちにていしゅつした。
translation: I submitted the necessary documents at a government office counter.
components: 宀 (roof) over two openings, an office under a roof.
mnemonic: Picture officials working behind the windows of a public office.
warning: 官 refers to public authority; 公務員 is the general word for civil servant.

kunyomi: ます; ふえる; ふやす
example: 最近、外国人観光客が増えている。
example_reading: さいきん、がいこくじんかんこうきゃくがふえている。
translation: Recently, the number of foreign tourists has been increasing.
components: 土 (earth) beside 曾, adding layers or amount.
mnemonic: Picture layers of earth piling up and increasing.
warning: 増える is intransitive; 増やす is transitive ‘increase something’.

example: 受付の係員に予約番号を見せた。
example_reading: うけつけのかかりいんによやくばんごうをみせた。
translation: I showed the reservation number to the receptionist in charge.
components: 亻 (person) beside 系 (thread), a person connected to a task.
mnemonic: Follow a thread to the person responsible for it.
warning: 係る is formal ‘concern’; 係員 is read かかりいん, not けいいん.

example: 助けてくれた友人に深く感謝している。
example_reading: たすけてくれたゆうじんにふかくかんしゃしている。
translation: I am deeply grateful to the friend who helped me.
components: 咸 over 心 (heart), an impression felt in the heart.
mnemonic: A strong sound reaches the heart and creates a feeling.
warning: 感心 means admiration; 関心 means interest and uses 関.

example: 最新の情報を公式サイトで確認してください。
example_reading: さいしんのじょうほうをこうしきサイトでかくにんしてください。
translation: Please check the latest information on the official website.
components: 忄 (heart) beside 青, a heart’s state or condition.
mnemonic: Picture a blue heart displaying a changing emotional state.
warning: 情報 is information; 情け is compassion and is read なさけ.

example: 将来のために少しずつ貯金を投資に回している。
example_reading: しょうらいのためにすこしずつちょきんをとうしにまわしている。
translation: I am gradually putting some savings into investments for the future.
components: 扌 (hand) beside 殳 (weapon), a hand throwing something.
mnemonic: Picture a hand throwing a stone toward a future target.
warning: 投げる means throw; 投じる is a formal or figurative ‘put/invest’.

example: 画面にエラーメッセージが表示された。
example_reading: がめんにエラーメッセージがひょうじされた。
translation: An error message appeared on the screen.
components: A ritual altar with objects displayed upon it.
mnemonic: Picture an altar showing a clear sign to everyone.
warning: 示す is ‘show’; 表示 is display, while 指示 is an instruction.

example: 予定が変わったので、会議の日を変更します。
example_reading: よていがかわったので、かいぎのひをへんこうします。
translation: Since the schedule changed, I will change the meeting date.
components: 亦 over 攵, a marked action that alters something.
mnemonic: Picture a tap of action turning an old shape into a new one.
warning: 変わる is intransitive; 変える takes an object and means change it.

example: キーボードで住所を打ち込んだ。
example_reading: キーボードでじゅうしょをうちこんだ。
translation: I typed the address into the keyboard.
components: 扌 (hand) beside 丁, a hand striking a precise point.
mnemonic: Tap a hand against a neat nail to make a precise mark.
warning: 打つ covers hit, type, inject, and play a shot; context determines the meaning.

kunyomi: ただちに; なおす; なおる
example: 壊れた椅子を自分で直した。
example_reading: こわれたいすをじぶんでなおした。
translation: I repaired the broken chair myself.
components: 十 over 目 with a vertical line, looking straight ahead.
mnemonic: An eye looks straight through a central line to correct the course.
warning: 直る is something gets fixed; 直す is someone fixes it.

example: 両親から旅行のお土産が届いた。
example_reading: りょうしんからりょこうのおみやげがとどいた。
translation: A souvenir from my parents’ trip arrived.
components: A balanced shape showing two sides within a frame.
mnemonic: Picture two equal compartments held together in one frame.
warning: 両方 means both; 二つ simply means two items.

example: 入学式は来週の月曜日に行われます。
example_reading: にゅうがくしきはらいしゅうのげつようびにおこなわれます。
translation: The entrance ceremony will be held next Monday.
components: 弋 (ceremonial stake) with 工, a prescribed form.
mnemonic: Picture a formal stake and construction frame defining a ceremony’s format.
warning: 式 means ceremony or formula; 様式 means style or mode.

kunyomi: たしか; たしかめる
example: 出発時刻をもう一度確認した。
example_reading: しゅっぱつじこくをもういちどかくにんした。
translation: I checked the departure time once more.
components: 石 (stone) beside 隺, firm and reliable like stone.
mnemonic: A stone is a certain, solid reference point to check against.
warning: 確かに means certainly; 確かめる means verify something.

kunyomi: はたす; はてる; はて
example: 努力の結果、試験に合格できた。
example_reading: どりょくのけっか、しけんにごうかくできた。
translation: As a result of my effort, I was able to pass the exam.
components: A tree bearing a round fruit at its top.
mnemonic: Picture a tree’s fruit as the visible result of growth.
warning: 結果 is result; 果たす means fulfill or accomplish a duty.
